outlook.statement: The project is expected to be fully implemented by financial year 2027-2028. The enhanced capacity will strengthen the Company's ability to cater to the growing market demand, improve operational efficiencies and achieve economies of scale.

With the latest technology, company will be able to produce quality products at lowest cost of production. Company shall enjoy the benefit of improved quality, productivity & saving in manufacturing costs.

The long-term outlook for BOPP films remains favourable, particularly in India, where demographic trends, urbanisation, higher disposable incomes, growth of branded packaged goods and expansion of organised retail support increasing packaging intensity. Industry research continues to project growth in Indian BOPP demand over the coming years.

For FY 2026-27, however, the operating environment is expected to remain dynamic. Demand growth should be healthy, but the benefit may be partly offset by additional industry capacity and competitive pricing. Margins are therefore likely to remain sensitive to utilisation levels, polypropylene-film spreads, raw-material volatility, export

The Company intends to remain focused on profitable volume growth rather than volume alone. Strengthening customer relationships, improving the share of differentiated products, maintaining manufacturing efficiency, controlling finance and logistics costs and preserving a sound balance between domestic and export sales will be central to the Company's strategy.

Subject to stable macroeconomic conditions and disciplined industry behaviour, the Company's expanded capacity should position it to participate in the next phase of growth in the Indian flexible-packaging market.
